name: Wisteria's Heavenly Knight
source:
A Distortion to meet in [i]A Case of Missing Identity.[/i] [b]Wisteria's Heavenly Knight[/b] is a grieving lover turned into a monster on her path for vengeance. Believing her Tether to be responsible for the death of her beloved lady, this Distortion has grasped upon a powerful sword called the Warlord's Fang to avenge her death. She will stop at nothing until her lover's murderer is dead - no matter how much power the sword draws from her, how many people must fall, or even how deeply her flesh is warped, she will not rest until she skewers her Tether upon the Warlord's Fang. From the moment she took the sword, her lifespan's clock began to tick. Will she enact her revenge, or will the clock reach 0 before the fated duel?

As a character, [b]Wisteria's Heavenly Knight[/b] speaks bluntly and brutally. She has a one-track mind of revenge against her Tether and all other Tetherkind, and will openly push Perdita into becoming a monster alongside her, as it will mean more weapons against those she hates.
